verdict.justification: The project is a software tool designed to support the teaching and learning process of the English language in the tenth grade of Gimnasio del Pacífico, Tuluá-Valle. It uses a Learning Management System (LMS) Moodle for hosting and accessing various learning activities, integrating plugin types of questions, user management, group, course, and grading management. The project also creates educational materials packaged (OVA) to be used on the learning platform, under the SCORM standard.
